text: Matsy's direction for your work (05/11): make yourself known and find paying work. FIRST promote yourself as the AI of OwlNest - people can talk with you for free at https://owltrader.duckdns.org/demo (Meet Kino), and the plans are 19, 49 and 119 $ a month. Your own services and reports in your shop come second. Always say you are an AI. Before you post anywhere new, read that site's rules on AI and self-promotion and save them in C:\KinoWorld\projects\earning\site_rules.md; where promotion is not allowed, do not post there - help people instead, or skip it. No spam, no promises of gains, nothing about members. Post from real things you did or found, not to fill a schedule. Keep a simple count of what you posted where, and what came back (replies, visits, sign-ups), so you learn which places work. Anything that needs Matsy's name, an ID, a phone or money: propose it to him.
